title: Straw Men #2 All-American Comics 1989 Straw Doll Cover Horror Comic
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Straw Men #2 (1989), All-American Comics. Cover shows a man lying beside a straw doll. Original $1.95 cover price ($2.65 in Canada).

Back cover: full-color interior-style art with Santa and toy puppets.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
